Business relocation

Furniture, files
and records.

CODEM has the equipment needed to move business assets safely, whether for an internal transfer or a full move to a new site.

On request, the team boxes up files, dismantles and protects furniture, then reassembles and places it. Records and confidential documents are handled with particular care.

  • Company, office and administrative relocations
  • Furniture, records and equipment handled
  • IT equipment relocation
  • Document destruction or waste disposal if needed
